thesis: We present the formalization of Doob's martingale convergence theorems in the mathlib library for the Lean theorem prover.

nodes.body: This work on martingale theory is one of the first developments of probability theory in mathlib, and it builds upon diverse parts of that library such as topology, analysis and most importantly measure theory.
